summary: C-MLP-03 slice 2: inference in setup. The model provider layer adds a Chutes adapter (subnet 64, Chat Completions, the miner's bearer key). Its per-token prices are read from Chutes' public model list and recorded with that list and the UTC time read. A model Chutes does not price is refused at setup, and spend settles on metered usage at the published price, because a Chutes charge report is unverified. Setup now offers every adapter, with Engy's Chat Completions route as the default. Chutes and the OpenAI-compatible adapters take a typed model id. The OpenAI-compatible adapters launch only as the setup's own choice, with the miner's endpoint and optional declared price in the profile, so no launch request can name a new URL. Chutes leaves the unavailable list, and battery's research-environment model provision is Provided. Live completions with miner-held Chutes and Engy keys remain the slice's acceptance. Engineering evidence only; nothing is qualified, and no chain write is made.
